keyCharacteristics: Deep navy frame, cool gray canvas, soft white cards.
One bright blue for actions; status colors only for outcomes and grades.
Apple's system font, with big tabular numbers for scores.
Rounded, gently lifted cards; one dark navy panel per page at most, reserved for the moment that matters (the call box).
Plain, coach-like copy in sentence case.

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: Action Blue marks what to do next. A screen has one primary blue button; everything else is secondary or a text link.

rules.name: The Status Means Status Rule
rules.body: Green, amber, and red describe how a call or skill went and nothing else. They are never decoration, section accents, or stripes on cards.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: All headings, labels, buttons, and badges are sentence case. No all-caps labels, and no small label above a heading: the heading carries the meaning ("Next focus: Solution Fit").

rules.name: The One Change Format Rule
rules.body: Every change reads arrow, size, unit: "↑ 8 pts", "↓ 3", "↑ 4%", or "Same", in Booked Green or Missed Red.

rules.name: The One Dark Panel Rule
rules.body: At most one dark navy panel per page, and only for the moment that matters most.

dos: Do keep one primary Action Blue button per screen.
Do show every number with tabular figures, and write every change the same way ("↑ 8 pts").
Do keep rows and columns on the shared 20px gap, with equal-height columns in a row.
Do write labels and buttons in plain sentence case.
donts: Don't add colored stripes or borders to cards to show category; use the icon chip and title.
Don't scatter small line charts across cards; trend charts live on the Analytics page.
Don't use green, amber, or red for anything except how a call or skill went.
Don't add a second dark navy panel to a page.
Don't use all-caps labels or a small eyebrow label above a heading.
Don't add colored side borders thicker than 1px to cards, callouts, or alerts; use a tinted background.
Don't use the pale Mist gray (faint) for text; it is for decoration only. Secondary text is Slate (muted).
